sourceBoundary: Removing the macOS-only Security import, helper and two conditional-option branches reproduces the entire original source byte-for-byte.

findings.finding: SecTask entitlement absence cannot establish absence of an effective inherited sandbox. The candidate's absent/false branch and verified-non-sandboxed statement therefore need a documented conservative policy or evidence for inherited hosts, especially because the file service persists bookmarks across launches.
findings.notClaimed: Ordinary Foundation bookmarks do not themselves bypass kernel Sandbox. No private sandbox API, permission override, fallback after arbitrary failure, or test-only process override is proposed.

findings.finding: The helper promises unknown entitlement values remain scoped. Check CFGetTypeID(entitlement) == CFBooleanGetTypeID() before converting, so the policy depends on an actual Boolean rather than numeric bridging.
findings.status: Requested exact type guard; no native bridging probe run.

checked: SecTask error object is consumed and errors keep original scoped policy
All public API, capability, registry, root, path, lifetime and test code outside the bounded change preserved
nativeValidation: NOT_RUN by reviewer; owner Foundation probe alone does not validate all inherited contexts.
